title: Demo Urban Traffic Scene Dataset
description: This dataset contains multimodal traffic scene imagery collected from urban roadway environments to support research in intelligent transportation systems, computer vision, and traffic safety analytics. The dataset includes sampled roadway frames, semantic scene tags, and CLIP-based visual embeddings generated through automated AI pipelines. Data were collected under varying lighting, weather, and traffic conditions to enable benchmarking and development of machine learning models for transportation applications.
purpose_of_collection: Traffic Scene Understanding and Safety Analytics
preferred_citation: Example Transportation Research Lab (2026). Demo Urban Traffic Scene Dataset. Traffic Atlas.
